key.name: open-spotlight
key.description: The key that opens Spotlight from anywhere, and closes it again.

key.name: web-search
key.description: A search address, with %s where the words go.

key.name: search-files
key.description: From GNOME's own index of your files.

key.name: search-web
key.description: "Search the web for …", last in the list.

key.name: clipboard-history
key.description: What is copied is listed in Spotlight's Clipboard, held in memory only and forgotten on logging out. Nothing a password manager marks as secret is kept.

key.name: clipboard-keep
key.summary: How long the clipboard history keeps things
key.description: 30 minutes, 8 hours or 7 days, and never past logging out.

key.name: glass-window
key.description: Blurs the desktop behind Glasswork's window, and tells Glasswork to let it show through.
